story_sequence.text: `beacon-deep` writes detailed artifacts into `docs/beacon/<version>/deep/<feature>/` and `.machine/deep/<feature>/`; the research file stores only `Deep Summary` index metadata.
`beacon-learn` writes learning audit data into `docs/beacon/<version>/learning/<feature>.md` or support transaction; the research file stores only `Learning Influence Summary`.
`docs/brainstorms/` is not a default target for explicit Beacon version+feature support analysis.
Repeated support clarification in the same version appends rounds or supersedes owned sections in the same research file instead of creating sibling files.
Cross-version clarification creates a new version research file with lineage fields for previous research, carried-forward findings, and superseded assumptions.
Gate / requirement clarity blocks invalid support write topology and reports source skill, expected path, actual path, and repair route.
Read-only support output is not persisted until Beacon determines the write target from version, feature, and support surface class; unresolved routing fails closed instead of using legacy fallback.
